verdicts.rationale: Both 'Very short-term conceptual memory', Potter 1993, Memory & Cognition 21(2):156-161, identical DOI.
Both 'Word selection in reading sentences', Potter/Stiefbold/Moryadas 1998, identical fields and DOI.
Both 'Recognition and Memory for Briefly Presented Scenes', Potter 2012, identical DOI and fields.
Both 'Japanese Honorifics as Emotive Definite Descriptions', Potts & Kawahara 2004, SALT 14, same DOI.
Both 'The Logic of Conventional Implicatures', Potts 2005, Oxford UP; publisher just abbreviated differently.
Both Pratt 'Risk(-)Aversion in the Small and in the Large', Econometrica; the 1964 member is the original of the DOI-bearing entry, same work despite year metadata differences.
Both 'Map semantics', Ian Pratt 1993, LNCS, same DOI; member just adds volume 716.
Both 'Do Both Pictures and Words Function as Symbols...', Preissler & Carey 2004, identical DOI and fields.
All three 'Narration in the Fiction Film', Bordwell 1986, identical publisher/ISBN; only citekeys differ.
Both 'Thinking and Experience', H. H. Price; different editions (1962 Harvard / 1969 Hutchinson 2nd) of the same work.

verdicts.rationale: Both 'Optimality Theory: Constraint Interaction in Generative Grammar' 1993; survivor omits Smolensky but it is the same canonical Prince & Smolensky work (book vs ROA techreport).
Both 'Furnishing the Mind', Jesse Prinz 2004, MIT Press, identical ISBN.
Both 'The Intermediate Level Theory of Consciousness', Prinz 2007, same DOI and fields.
Both 'Principles of feature integration in visual perception', Prinzmetal 1981, identical DOI and fields.
Both 'The Phenomenology of Attention', Prinzmetal et al 1997, identical author list, DOI, and fields.
Both 'The Internalization of Perceptual Processing Constraints', Proffitt & Kaiser 1998, identical DOI and fields.
Both 'XII—Why Are Indexicals Essential?', Prosser 2015, identical DOI and fields.
Both 'Subjective hierarchies in spatial memory', McNamara/Hardy/Hirtle 1989, same DOI.
Both 'Conversation, co-ordination and convention', Garrod & Doherty 1994, identical DOI and fields.
All four are Pudovkin's 'Film Technique and Film Acting', various editions/reprints (1949-1970) of the same work.

Both 'Synonymity, and the Analysis of Belief Sentences', Putnam 1954, Analysis, same DOI.
Both 'Psychological Predicates', Putnam 1967, Art Mind and Religion, identical DOI and fields.
Both 'Is Semantics Possible?', Putnam; 1970 original and 1975 reprint of the same essay.
Both 'Reductionism and the nature of psychology', Putnam 1973, Cognition 2(1):131-146, same DOI.
